title: Go: Circuit Breaker
description: Build a circuit breaker with CLOSED/OPEN/HALF-OPEN states, failure counting, half-open probes, and event callbacks.

steps.title: State enum and transitions
steps.description: Define a `State` type as `int` with constants `StateClosed`, `StateOpen`, `StateHalfOpen`. Implement `String() string` for each. Create a `CircuitBreaker` struct with `state State`. Print the initial state and a transition to `StateOpen` using `fmt.Println(cb.State())`.
hints: Use `iota` for state constants starting from 0.

verification.failureMessage: Initial state should be CLOSED, then transition to OPEN.

steps.title: Failure counting in a window
steps.description: Implement failure counting over a sliding time window. Store failure timestamps in a slice `[]time.Time`. `recordFailure()` appends the current time and prunes entries older than `window time.Duration`. `failureCount() int` returns the count. Call `Call(action func() error)` that records failures on error and opens the circuit if threshold exceeded. Print `"circuit open"` after enough failures.
hints: Check `failureCount() >= threshold` after each failure to trip the breaker.

verification.successMessage: Breaker opens after threshold failures in window.
verification.failureMessage: After N failures within the window, the circuit should open.

steps.title: Half-open probe with timer
steps.description: When in `StateOpen`, start a `time.Timer` for the configured timeout. After the timeout, transition to `StateHalfOpen`. Print `"half-open"` when the probe timer fires. Implement `halfOpenTimer(time.Duration)`.
hints: Use a goroutine or `time.AfterFunc` to transition after timeout.
Cancel the old timer if the circuit closes again (reset).

verification.successMessage: Breaker transitions to half-open after timeout.
verification.failureMessage: After the open timeout, state should change to HALF_OPEN.

steps.title: Success threshold recovery
steps.description: In `StateHalfOpen`, allow a limited number of probe calls. If `successCount` reaches a `halfOpenMaxSuccesses` threshold, transition back to `StateClosed`. If any probe call fails, transition to `StateOpen`. Print `"circuit closed"` on recovery.
hints: Increment on success; if `>= halfOpenMaxSuccesses`, close the circuit.
On any failure in half-open, go back to open (restart the timer).

verification.successMessage: Breaker closes after success threshold in half-open.
verification.failureMessage: After enough successful probes, the circuit should close.

steps.title: Events and callbacks
steps.description: Add `OnStateChange func(old, new State)` callback. Call it on every state transition. Implement `Subscribe(func(event StateEvent))` pattern. Print `"CLOSED->OPEN"` etc. when transitions occur.
hints: Store a `[]func(State, State)` slice of listeners.
Call all listeners in the transition method.
Use `go` to invoke callbacks asynchronously if desired.

verification.failureMessage: Callbacks should receive old and new state on transitions.

steps.title: Metrics and reporting
steps.description: Implement a `Metrics` struct tracking: `TotalCalls int`, `SuccessCount int`, `FailureCount int`, `StateCounts map[State]int`. Update on each call. Print a metrics report using `fmt.Printf("Metrics: calls=%d successes=%d failures=%d", m.TotalCalls, m.SuccessCount, m.FailureCount)`.
hints: Increment counters in `Call()` before and after the action.
`StateCounts` increments every time the state changes.

verification.failureMessage: Metrics should track total calls, successes, and failures.
